verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing has a first-party Entitlements docs page that describes determining when to grant or revoke product feature access to customers. This shows the product itself has an entitlements capability. However, the evidence is a single thin line and does not show how features are modeled or attached to plans, or how an application checks entitlements at runtime. Missing for 10: documentation of features/limits attached to plans or products, a documented runtime entitlement-check API or SDK method, limit/quota modeling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, features and limits are modeled as entitlements attached to plans, and my application can check a customer's entitlements at runtime via API or SDK

citations.quote: Determine when you can grant or revoke product feature access to customers.
